Anyone standing within the storm may be affected by either Energizing Chaotic Magic I or Revitalizing Chaotic Magic I. Energizing Chaotic Magic I restores 1% mana and endurance while draining 2% health every 6 seconds and upon landing. Revitalizing Chaotic Magic I drains 0.2% mana and endurance while restoring 2% health every 6 seconds and upon landing.
